how: tools/moriarty_preimages.mjs drives output/contract/index.js through @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime 0.19.100 (onchain-runtime-v4 4.0.0-rc.3, the same onchain-runtime version as midnight-ledger 92e8bdd3); the proof data of each call is serialised by proofDataIntoSerializedPreimage and decoded by the preimage-json binary (experiments/zkir-k/tools/preimage-json, built in the ledger-92e8bdd3 workspace).
fixed_fields: binding_input is 0 and the communications-commitment randomness is 0. The binding input is a placeholder that the ledger overwrites at transaction assembly (ledger/src/construct.rs: `binding_input = 0u8.into()`, populated during proving), which is not performed here. The randomness is not overwritten by the ledger: the DApp supplies it in the call prototype (`call.communication_commitment_rand`, ledger/src/construct.rs:565-568) and the runtime used here passes 0. key_location (dummy) is dropped.

swap-fundAlice.scenario: fresh contract (WaitingAlice), block time before the deadline

swap-fundBob.scenario: after fundAlice (WaitingBob), block time before the deadline

swap-decide.scenario: after fundBob (WaitingDecision), decision=1 (settle), block time before the deadline

swap-expire.scenario: after fundBob (WaitingDecision), block time past the deadline; refunds both deposits

escrow-fund.scenario: fresh contract (Waiting); buyer witness matches buyerAuthority

escrow-release.scenario: after fund (Funded); buyer witness matches buyerAuthority

escrow-refundAfterTimeout.scenario: after fund (Funded), block time past the deadline
